correctness.rationale: For real periodic H1 with weighted mean zero, the centered resistance kernel represents evaluation. Expanding ∫R gives K_mu(x)=1/(12M²)+(αR(x,0)+βR(x,d))/M−αβd(1−d)/M². Each arc has a strict concave quadratic; the long-arc vertex gives K=1/(12M²)+S/(4M)−αβd(d+S)/(SM²), including d=0 and d=1/2 ties. The nonnegative mass-imbalance/separation deficit factors exactly, forcing α=β and d=1/2; equality functions are centered Green representers. Independent exact-rational substitution at three profiles, including S=1 giving 19/192, agreed. The finite tests do not replace the proof.
